note: Large wooded North Shore campground on the point between the Gooseberry River mouth and Lake Superior, a short walk on park trails to the rocky shore, Lakeview Shelter and Agate Beach; Gooseberry Falls and the visitor center lie upriver by Highway 61. Many driveways are not level, and some are shared double driveways. --Claude
summary: DNR park data + campground map + full ReserveMN catalog: 69 drive-in sites (68 on ReserveMN), no electric, 3 pull-throughs, 40-ft RV limit, pads 20-40 ft; showers/flush/vault/dump/water; year-round (3 plowed sites in winter); $25 re-read. Waterfront upgrade to coastal walk flagged; pin is north of Highway 61 in the woods, move flagged; phone added in flags.
flags: WATERFRONT: upgrade not waterfront -> coastal walk (Lake Superior). The DNR campground map puts the Main Campground on the wooded point between the Gooseberry River mouth and Lake Superior, with the Lakeview Shelter, picnic-flow area and Agate Beach on the shore beside it, reached on park trails and roads. ReserveMN tags 26 of 68 sites 'Lake/River/Creek: < 1/8 mile' and the rest '< .25 mile'; none is tagged Water Front. Imagery: the east side of the loop (sites ~52-70 on the DNR map, around 47.1395,-91.4585) lies under canopy roughly 50-150 m from the rocky shoreline, with only a park road and the forest between; Highway 61 is on the far (north-west) side of the river, about 700 m away, so no highway, town, rail or residential strip lies between camp and lake. No site has an open-ground view, so not lakefront. The stored note's 'back from Lake Superior' undersold it.

Pin: stored 47.14570,-91.46540 plots in forest NORTH of Highway 61 and the river (imagery), not at the park. The campground loop is at about 47.1394,-91.4608 (imagery estimate, centre of the site loops; ~800 m SSE of the stored pin). Recommend the move; elevation_meters (252) will want re-reading at the new point (the camp sits much nearer lake level, ~183 m).
Phone: none stored. DNR contact: 218-595-7100 (park). apply.py does not write phones: add 218-595-7100.

Site count: DNR says 69 drive-in sites; ReserveMN carries 68 drive-in units (plus 3 tent-only group camps and a paddle-in kayak site the DNR lists separately). Count 69 written from the DNR; the stored 70 came from note prose.

Site notes on ReserveMN: many 'Driveway is not level', several 'Hard to back into', and three pairs of shared 'Double driveway ... doesn't work for larger units' (e.g. 29/30, 20/22). Not an access problem the agency raises for the park road, so no warn; the note mentions it.

Websites OK: DNR index.html redirects to park.html?id=spk00172; ReserveMN #!park/118 is Gooseberry Falls State Park. Policy row state:MN not contradicted (100% reservation system; off-season self-registration through the same system).
Status: open. DNR alert (Nov 7-22 deer hunt) closes only trails north of Highway 61 to day use; not a campground closure.
